visualCharacteristics.notes: Full-width centered pull quote: large uppercase headline-font quotation with a decorative opening quote mark above it, followed by a small uppercase grey attribution line. No portrait, no background.

contentPattern.structure: row 1: quotation paragraph(s); row 2 (optional): attribution paragraph (italic text becomes <cite>). Rendered as figure > blockquote + figcaption

suitableFor: executive or customer quotes with a name | company attribution
notSuitableFor: testimonials with portraits or carousels of quotes
headings or callout statements that are not quotations
